topology_origin.external_input_rule: slot 0 is external only until an earlier step writes slot 0
topology_origin.internal_input_rule: each input resolves to the latest prior step that wrote the consumed slot

transition_spec.role_policy: canonical input-port roles or valid x- extension roles
transition_spec.semantic_policy: roles are caller-declared and never inferred from numerical layer type

binding.external_anchor: persistent input-port edge binding on the same step
binding.internal_anchor: persistent semantic lifecycle transition on the latest prior writer step
binding.continuity_check: expected_input_roles must exactly match resolved upstream semantic roles by input position
binding.immutability: first successful transition wins; identical rebinding is idempotent and conflicting rebinding fails closed

provenance.history_policy: upstream provenance fingerprints are snapshotted into each immutable transition

invariants: lifecycle binding never changes executable graph plan bytes
lifecycle binding never mutates AgentWorkspace or LayerRegistry
slot number alone never proves external-input origin after that slot has been overwritten
semantic roles are never inferred from layer type
downstream lifecycle binding fails if upstream semantic provenance is missing
conflicting rebinding fails without rewriting existing provenance

examples.meaning: explicit agent-declared semantic lifecycle over ordered graph steps
state transformation remains descriptive provenance, not runtime policy
